description: Generate a new local Ethereum EOA and add it to ~/.splits/config.json (mode 0600). The key is used by `splits transactions sign` to approve multisig transactions locally. Several keys can be saved; they are not tied to a workspace. By default creates the key only; pass --register to also register the address with the backend in one call (equivalent to `create-key` + `register-signer <address>`). On registration failure the new local key is removed so the next attempt starts fresh.

name.description: Optional human-readable label. Defaults to a short form of the address.

register.description: Also register the new address with the backend so it can be attached as a signer. On backend failure the local key is rolled back.

workspace.description: Workspace alias to run this command in (see `splits auth workspaces`). Overrides SPLITS_WORKSPACE and the active workspace.

name: auth_create-key
